brand.philosophy: Hongqi (红旗, “Red Flag”) is one of China's most prestigious automotive brands. Since its foundation in 1958, Hongqi has symbolized national pride, advanced engineering, and uncompromising quality.
brand.description: Today, Hongqi is a modern luxury marque that blends the heritage of Chinese craftsmanship with cutting-edge technology. Every vehicle is built with meticulous attention to detail, delivering outstanding comfort and safety.

heritage.title: Heritage
heritage.text: Over 65 years of history. Hongqi served state leaders and became a symbol of prestige in China.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.text: Advanced electrification, autonomous driving, and artificial intelligence technologies.

craftsmanship.title: Craftsmanship
craftsmanship.text: Hand-assembled key components, premium materials, and attention to every detail.

safety.title: Safety
safety.text: Hongqi Total Safety Management is a number-one priority.

milestones.1958: Hongqi is founded. The first CA72 model is released.
milestones.1981: Hongqi becomes an official ceremonial vehicle for state events.
milestones.2018: Brand relaunch with a new design strategy and lineup.
milestones.2020: International expansion. Launch of the E-HS9 electric lineup.
milestones.2023: Hongqi enters Kazakhstan. Luxury Auto becomes an official dealer.
milestones.2024: Lineup expands to 8 models. Record sales.
